$schema-doc.description: Plugin catalog — external-tool integrations. codeadd owns utilization, never installation. Each entry keyed by plugin name. Schema per entry:

fields.description: string — one-line summary shown in `plugins list`.
fields.detect: string — shell probe; exit-0 means the tool is present (hard gate).
fields.homepage: string — tool's homepage, printed on validation failure.
fields.installHint: string — how the user installs the tool themselves.
fields.postEnableHint: string — printed after a successful enable (setup/index steps).
fields.injects: string[] — command names that receive fragment injection.
fields.skills: string[] — plugin-bound skill names copied into each provider on enable.
fields.agents: { agent: string, sections: string[] }[] — agent definitions that receive per-agent fragment injection; carries the capability across the command→subagent dispatch boundary.

gitnexus.description: Code knowledge-graph navigation (calls, refs, blast-radius) via MCP
gitnexus.postEnableHint:
gitnexus enabled. Make the graph usable:
  1) gitnexus setup     # wire MCP (once)
  2) gitnexus analyze   # index this repo (from repo root)
  3) verify: ask Claude to run gitnexus list_repos (or /mcp) — this repo MUST appear indexed; if it does not, the commands silently fall back to grep.
Re-run analyze after large changes. Docs: https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus

playwright.description: Adds live browser driving (screenshots + console/network) to the already-present QA validation via Playwright MCP
playwright.installHint: Install the Playwright MCP server (@playwright/mcp) + chromium, then wire it as an MCP server. Run /add.qa-setup for guided, per-OS install + project QA config. Tool: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp
playwright.postEnableHint:
playwright enabled — adds live browser driving to the already-present QA validation. Make it runnable:
  1) /add.qa-setup        # install prereqs (chromium + Playwright MCP) + scaffold project QA config
  2) verify the Playwright MCP server is connected (e.g. /mcp) — it MUST appear; if not, add.qa runs in degraded read-PNG mode
  3) /add.qa <feature-id> [SFxx]   # run the audit
Docs: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp
